source: Spec 124 R-DA (McDonald's Airtight V3): every entry is the measured PRE -> POST diff of docs/reports/golden/compute_coa_cost_estimates/{pre,post}/{coa,standalone}.json. PRE = the legacy-shell captures of Night A-swap 2026-10-22 (lane COA-ASWAP); POST = the converted-shell captures retaken in the Fleet recapture night 2026-10-22 (run-20261022b; Spec 132 §x-captures.3 (R-DA); Q-B refresh from VALIDATE-REPORT-2 §2). Each why is explained from the descriptor deviation, register rule, runner code or the captures' own measured values it names, and states tonight's cause (the committed A-swap POSTs were empty-cursor runs; tonight's plain coa POSTs did real pending work because the coa root ran first). table_state moves in both files (see table_state[0].content_hash); row counts 33,982 / 274,986 unchanged.

diffs.why: PIPELINE_META is derived from the descriptor inputs.reads (Spec 122 §5.1, R-BJ): neighbourhood_id and project_type swap order against the legacy hand-written list; the converted list also names trade_classified_at / cost_classified_at and the cost columns the declared checks read. No legacy read is dropped.

PIPELINE_META is derived from the descriptor outputs.writes (Spec 122 §5.1, R-BJ): the key (id) leads the column list [id, modeled_gfa_sqm, estimated_cost, cost_source, cost_classified_at]; the legacy list started with modeled_gfa_sqm. Same column set.

R-EQ shell swap: the legacy shell hand-printed JSON-log lines ("Loaded 35 trade configs / 805 logic variables from control panel", the pricing progress and summary lines) and a hyphenated completion line; the runner prints its own lines (the target line "database=postgres user=postgres migrations=<n>", the ledger-gate line where the step gates, the PIPELINE_SUMMARY and PIPELINE_META lines and one "[compute_coa_cost_estimates] completed in <DUR>" line). Log lines only: no table, counter or verdict value is read from them, and the PIPELINE_SUMMARY content is diffed separately in the summary.* keys.
